final.memo:
We have reviewed the Company following its July 1, 2015 separation into a focused medical-products and renal-care business [D01, D03]. Despite its $22.93bn market capitalization, we find the current investment thesis speculative as it lacks a discrete event or identified catalyst to drive value [D04, D07].

Our evaluation of the business is hindered by the lack of a reconciled standalone balance sheet, segment-level EBITDA data, and peer margin benchmarks [D01, D05]. Without these, we cannot perform a rigorous sum-of-the-parts analysis or determine a reliable margin of safety for the $42.13 share price [D01, D04].

While the market expresses concern regarding standalone overhead, currency fluctuations, and renal reimbursement pressures, these are operational issues rather than a mispriced event [D05]. We require a concrete governance plan or a structural mispricing to commit capital, neither of which is present in the current situation [D03, D07].

Consequently, we pass on the opportunity and will monitor the company's H2 2015 performance—specifically the $0.58-$0.62 EPS guidance—from the sidelines [D03, D04]. We require more than a generic operational turnaround to warrant our involvement [D07].
